title: Adult and sexually explicit content: publication and access
summary: Pornography is prohibited or blocked outright in many Muslim-majority and authoritarian states and restricted by obscenity or censorship rules elsewhere. Separately, a growing number of jurisdictions (UK, France, Italy, Germany, Australia) require age verification. Not listed individually: about half of US states (e.g. Texas, Florida, Louisiana, Utah, Virginia, Arizona and many more) have age-verification laws for sites with substantial adult content (upheld in Free Speech Coalition v. Paxton, 2025); the EU DSA guidelines and other countries (e.g. Spain, Brazil, Canada proposals) are evolving. Most entries rest on general knowledge plus country reports; verify with counsel.

countries.name: Saudi Arabia
countries.note: from general knowledge, unverified. Pornography and sexually explicit material are banned; websites blocked by CST under Anti-Cyber Crime Law (public morality).

countries.name: United Arab Emirates
countries.note: from general knowledge, unverified. Obscene content prohibited under Cybercrime Law (Federal Decree-Law 34/2021) and Penal Code; sites blocked by TDRA.

countries.name: Iran
countries.note: from general knowledge, unverified. Production, distribution and access to pornography criminalised; extensive filtering.

countries.name: Iraq
countries.note: from general knowledge, unverified. Obscene material criminalised (Penal Code); porn sites blocked by authorities.

countries.name: Kuwait
countries.note: from general knowledge, unverified. Obscene content banned and blocked by CITRA; Cybercrime law 63/2015.

countries.name: Qatar
countries.note: from general knowledge, unverified. Pornography banned and filtered; Cybercrime Law 14/2014 and Penal Code.

countries.name: Oman
countries.note: from general knowledge, unverified. Pornographic content prohibited and blocked by TRA; Cyber Crime Law.

countries.name: Yemen
countries.note: from general knowledge, unverified. Pornography prohibited and filtered.

countries.name: Afghanistan
countries.note: from general knowledge, unverified. Taliban authorities ban and block pornographic and 'immoral' content.

countries.name: Pakistan
countries.note: PECA 2016 s.37 and Penal Code criminalise obscene content; PTA blocks porn sites.

countries.name: Indonesia
countries.note: Anti-Pornography Law 44/2008 and ITE Law; Kominfo/Komdigi blocks porn sites.

countries.name: Malaysia
countries.note: Communications and Multimedia Act 1998 s.211/233 and Penal Code s.292; MCMC blocks porn sites.

countries.name: Bangladesh
countries.note: Pornography Control Act 2012 and Digital Security/Cyber Security laws; BTRC blocks sites.

countries.name: China
countries.note: Production and dissemination of obscene material criminal (Criminal Law arts. 363-367); Great Firewall blocks porn; Minor-protection rules apply.

countries.name: North Korea
countries.note: from general knowledge, unverified. Pornography banned and severely punished; no open internet.

countries.name: Russia
countries.note: from general knowledge, unverified. Distribution of pornography is an offence (Criminal Code art. 242); Roskomnadzor blocks sites; VPN-related and age-related rules tightening; enforcement partial.

countries.name: Turkey
countries.note: Law 5651 allows BTK to block obscene content; many porn sites blocked; production/distribution criminal (TCK art. 226).

countries.name: India
countries.note: Publishing obscene material illegal (IT Act s.67, 67A; BNS); DoT/MeitY has ordered ISP blocks of porn sites; many sites accessible.

countries.name: Egypt
countries.note: Obscene content criminalised (Penal Code art. 178, Cybercrime Law 175/2018); sites blocked.

countries.name: Jordan
countries.note: from general knowledge, unverified. Porn sites blocked by TRC; Cybercrime Law 17/2023 and Penal Code.

countries.name: Sudan
countries.note: from general knowledge, unverified. Pornography banned and filtered by NTC.

countries.name: Libya
countries.note: from general knowledge, unverified. Pornography prohibited and filtered.

countries.name: Brunei
countries.note: from general knowledge, unverified. Pornography banned; Sharia Penal Code and Internet Code of Practice.

countries.name: Maldives
countries.note: from general knowledge, unverified. Pornography illegal and blocked.

countries.name: Vietnam
countries.note: Pornography banned (Penal Code, Decree 72/2013, Cybersecurity Law); sites blocked.

countries.name: Thailand
countries.note: Computer Crime Act and Penal Code s.287 prohibit obscene material; MDES blocks sites; limits on sale and distribution.

countries.name: Singapore
countries.note: Online Safety (Relevant Measures) Act and IMDA Internet Code of Practice; Undesirable Publications Act; porn sites blocked, age assurance for app stores/R18.

countries.name: South Korea
countries.note: Criminal Act art. 243-244 bans distribution of obscene material; KCSC blocks foreign porn sites; adult identity verification required.

countries.name: Japan
countries.note: Penal Code art. 175 criminalises distribution of uncensored obscene material; mosaic requirement; age checks recommended.

countries.name: United Kingdom
countries.note: Online Safety Act 2023: services with pornographic content must use highly effective age assurance (enforced since July 2025) or face Ofcom fines up to 10% turnover; also offence for extreme pornography.

countries.name: France
countries.note: SREN law 2024 and Arcom reference framework require age verification for porn sites; Arcom may block; Pornhub suspended service in France in 2025.

countries.name: Italy
countries.note: AGCOM rules require double-anonymity age verification for porn sites, in force from 2025; fines.

countries.name: Germany
countries.note: Interstate Treaty on Protection of Minors in the Media (JMStV): porn only behind closed user groups with age verification; KJM enforces, network blocking sought.

countries.name: Australia
countries.note: Online Safety Act 2021 industry codes (Phase 2) require age assurance for pornography; social media minimum age law separate; check eSafety for dates.

countries.name: Uzbekistan
countries.note: from general knowledge, unverified. Production and distribution of pornography criminal (Criminal Code art. 130); sites blocked.

countries.name: Belarus
countries.note: from general knowledge, unverified. Criminal Code art. 343 prohibits porn distribution; sites blocked.

countries.name: Syria
countries.note: from general knowledge, unverified. Pornography prohibited and filtered.

countries.name: Turkmenistan
countries.note: from general knowledge, unverified. Pornography prohibited; heavy internet censorship.

countries.name: Myanmar
countries.note: from general knowledge, unverified. Electronic Transactions Law and Telecommunications Law ban obscene content; blocked.

countries.name: Ethiopia
countries.note: from general knowledge, unverified. Criminal Code and Computer Crime proclamation penalise obscene publications.

countries.name: Bahrain
countries.note: from general knowledge, unverified. Porn sites blocked by TRA; Penal Code on obscenity.
